notes:
LIVE ITEM SPAWN UPDATE

- Added direct live item spawning while Rocket League is already running, with no game restart required.
- Kept equipped spawned vehicle items active when entering Casual, Ranked, Private and tournament matches and after match respawns.
- Fixed private-match and other reservation variants so the live loadout handoff works independently of the online mode.
- Reworked BondoSpawner with searchable categories, selection checkmarks, automatic selection clearing and per-item paint choices.
- Fixed Item Spawn, Titles and Name Changer sharing the same network runtime without blocking one another.
- Kept Item Swapper changes available while Rocket League is running and improved swap rollback and category validation.
- Added the Standard UI and Clean UI modes, reduced the Clean UI glass shine and corrected loading states, button hover and press feedback.
- Fixed Workshop download verification and progress reporting, and improved background startup and network cleanup.
- Marked Custom Macro as development in progress while controller recording is being stabilized.
